title: change_brief
description: Every document's changes for one period, merged into a single ID space and grouped into the running order of a cadence update. Produced by scripts/write_update.py; audited against the written update by scripts/qa_update.py.

items.description: A change record as in changes.schema.json, plus the fields below.

change_id.description: Renumbered across all documents. This is the ID the update cites.

local_change_id.description: The ID it had in its own document's changes.json.
